name: Unidentified long-necked species
description: A bipedal species lived in the galaxy during the Imperial Era. A species of tall, thin-necked beings, at least one member resided in a mining village on Mapuzo in 9 BBY, while another was present on the Spur Orbiting Market in 3 ABY. That individual was on the space station during an altercation between an Arcona bounty hunter and the cyborg Beilert Valance.
